entries.dialogueText: “I know he is a seasoned veteran with a career in law spanning over 30 years, but...”

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: "“Your new appointment to the Suprem..."
entries.dialogueText: “Your new appointment to the Supreme Court, Mr. Grecer, has been elected Chief Justice following the internal vote today.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“So, you don't trust him?”"
entries.dialogueText: “So, you don't trust him?”
entries.menuText: “So, you don't trust him?”

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: "“I want to. Everyone says he's one..."
entries.dialogueText: “I want to. Everyone says he's one of the most incorruptible judges out there. But I do not know this man in person. Nor I can ignore the fact that the Supreme Court was so quick to elect him.”

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: "“Your appointment to the Supreme Co..."
entries.dialogueText: “Your appointment to the Supreme Court, Mrs. Tory, has begun her duty as a Justice today.”

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: "“There is something else you need t..."
entries.dialogueText: “There is something else you need to know...”

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: "“I think we both know what she brin..."
entries.dialogueText: “I think we both know what she brings to the table. And I have to say that it was clever of you to remove her from the Assembly. She was a thorn in our side as the Speaker."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: "“In any case, we will have to wait..."
entries.dialogueText: “In any case, we will have to wait and see.”

entries.dialogueText: “There's also been a development in the opposition you should know about.”

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: "“As you know, Frens Ricter's... *ab..."
entries.dialogueText: “As you know, Frens Ricter's... *absence* in the Assembly left the PFJP in turmoil."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: "“They've been scrambling to keep th..."
entries.dialogueText: “They've been scrambling to keep the party intact without its leader.”

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: "“Or at least, that was the case unt..."
entries.dialogueText: “Or at least, that was the case until yesterday's PFJP congress.”

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: "“Here, take a look.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Here, take a look.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He handed me an official report fro..."
entries.dialogueText: He handed me an official report from the PFJP.

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: "“An unprecedented candidate from th..."
entries.dialogueText: “An unprecedented candidate from their ranks has been elected the new PFJP leader. Manoly Suheil.”

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: "“She was always a radical figure in..."
entries.dialogueText: “She was always a radical figure in their party. She and Ricter butted heads on numerous occasions, as I recall.”

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: "“Now that he's gone, she has been l..."
entries.dialogueText: “Now that he's gone, she has been let loose. I still don't know how she made it to that position, but they must have had a reason to elect someone like her.”

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: "“We know she is quite popular both..."
entries.dialogueText: “We know she is quite popular both in the Assembly and among middle-class women. She definitely has the potential to expand the PFJP's influence."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: "“We shouldn't underestimate her.”"
entries.dialogueText: “We shouldn't underestimate her.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“We won't.”"
entries.dialogueText: “We won't.”
entries.menuText: “We won't.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“What can she do when Frens couldn'..."
entries.dialogueText: “What can she do when Frens couldn't do anything?”
entries.menuText: “What can she do when Frens couldn't do anything?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“It'd be a shame if the same thing..."
entries.dialogueText: “It'd be a shame if the same thing happened to her as to Frens.”
entries.menuText: “It'd be a shame if the same thing happened to her as to Frens.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Don't be alarmed. We have nothing..."
entries.dialogueText: “Don't be alarmed. We have nothing to worry about.”
entries.menuText: “Don't be alarmed. We have nothing to worry about.”

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: "“You might be right. But better be..."
entries.dialogueText: “You might be right. But better be safe than sorry.”

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: "“I'm just going to pretend I didn't..."
entries.dialogueText: “I'm just going to pretend I didn't hear that."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: "“If she can tap into Ricter's base,..."
entries.dialogueText: “If she can tap into Ricter's base, she will have as much power as him or more. We will be watching her moves.”

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: "“Just as I expected from you.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Just as I expected from you.”

entries.dialogueText: “Another thing. I have received multiple reports that the NFP has chosen a replacement to lead in Kesaro Kibener's stead. It seems to be his former right-hand man.”

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: "“Remus Holstron, also known as the..."
entries.dialogueText: “Remus Holstron, also known as the 'Iron Wall'. I believe you two have met."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: "“As one of the most brutally cutthr..."
entries.dialogueText: “As one of the most brutally cutthroat Young Sords members, he was recruited by Kesaro himself during the coup when he was still in the military.”

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: "“Not the most charming fellow I've..."
entries.dialogueText: “Not the most charming fellow I've ever met...”

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: "“He is a ticking time bomb. Some na..."
entries.dialogueText: “He is a ticking time bomb. Some nationalists think he is *too extreme* compared to Mr. Kibener, especially for his deeply troubling anti-minority rhetoric.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“If he is the *Iron Wall* then I wi..."
entries.dialogueText: “If he is the *Iron Wall* then I will be the one that brings him down.”
entries.menuText: “If he is the *Iron Wall* then I will be the one that brings it down.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“He doesn't scare me. I have dealt..."
entries.dialogueText: “He doesn't scare me. I have dealt with much worse.”
entries.menuText: “He doesn't scare me. I have dealt with much worse.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Make sure he never becomes a big p..."
entries.dialogueText: “Make sure he never becomes a big problem then.”
entries.menuText: “Make sure he never becomes a big problem then.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“He can never *ever* hope to reach..."
entries.dialogueText: “He can never *ever* hope to reach Kesaro's level."
entries.menuText: “He can never *ever* hope to reach Kesaro's level."

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: "“What's more, he is basically worsh..."
entries.dialogueText: “What's more, he is basically worshipped among the Young Sords.”

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: "“He comes with an already strong ba..."
entries.dialogueText: “He comes with an already strong base and foundation. He will either expand the NFP's influence, or destroy what Kesaro had achieved.”

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: "“But I can say with certainty that..."
entries.dialogueText: “But I can say with certainty that he *will* be a problem.”

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: "“As much as I don't like the man, y..."
entries.dialogueText: “As much as I don't like the man, you might be right. However, let's not forget that Kesaro was labelled as *moderate* by NFP supporters...”

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: "“We will do our best.”"
entries.dialogueText: “We will do our best.”

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: "“It's better to be on the side of c..."
entries.dialogueText: “It's better to be on the side of caution.”

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: "“Silly nicknames don't win politics..."
entries.dialogueText: “Silly nicknames don't win politics after all.”
